scope: Reuse of previously read originals and pinned code, plus exact title/author metadata verification; no new experiments or canonical manuscript change.

claims.manuscript_support: Outer optimization of Lenia rules and initial states, with evolving body states under selected fixed rules.
locations: The Lenia environment (sec3) and IMGEP (sec4), Fig2–3

claims.manuscript_support: Standard fast-delta and eligibility-trace learning succeeded in the controlled within-lifetime acquisition/retention/reversal assay; no novel-method superiority follows.
claims.provenance: Reuses previous read of owner results and implementation; no result recomputation in this integration pass.

scope_limits: Two seeds crossed with two label orders are not four independent seeds.
No births in this host assay; no regeneration or newborn memory claim.
Experimenter-mediated cue/stimulus placement and preset physical executor are part of the task.
Unannounced reversal means the policy is not given the contingency switch. Before new evidence, an unobservable switch need not be immediately inferable.
Successful standard learners support a capability result, not an advantage for a learned update rule or universal sustained adaptation.
